title: Quote: I was worth about over a million dollars when I was 23 and o...
speaker: Steve Jobs
content: I was worth about over a million dollars when I was 23 and over ten million dollars when I was 24, and over a hundred million dollars when I was 25 and... it wasn't that important -- because I never did it for the money.
full_transcript: I was worth about over a million dollars when I was 23 and over ten million dollars when I was 24, and over a hundred million dollars when I was 25 and... it wasn't that important -- because I never did it for the money.
